scope: The semantic physics of the archive itself: charters, rooms, chambers, fields, heteronym provenance, continuity apparatus, protocols and instruments.

claims.what: Practices, concepts and objects the province holds.
claims.apparatus_study_line:
THE APPARATUS/STUDY LINE (operator, 2026-08-15). The JCS inaugural issue (#55, April 2026) predates the CHA province. Its INFRASTRUCTURE category housed the Space Ark, the Moltbot Swarm and the f.03 field because there was nowhere else to put them. Appearing in an issue is a PUBLICATION FACT, not a claim on the category. As LIVING SEMANTIC PHYSICS the apparatus belongs to the province.

  CHA takes the apparatus: field and chamber and room specifications, the Ark as operating vessel, swarms, mints as operating instruments, registries, protocols — the archive's own physics, in operation.
  JCS takes the study: compression theory, operative numismatics as a domain (the Coin, the Sharpie as semantic object), TANG, retrocausal canon formation, MPAIs and disambiguation packets as compressions, the holographic-kernel method.

Test: is this the thing operating, or a study of what happens when meaning is compressed? The Pearl Mint's operational specification is apparatus. 'The Thousand Dollar Sharpie' is study.
